pending_interview.category: System design (general) — scalability patterns; designing common systems like a URL shortener, rate limiter, chat system, notification system
pending_interview.question: Design a rate limiter — that is, a system that limits how many requests a single user or API client can make within a given time window (for example, no more than 1,000 requests per minute per user). Walk through the high-level components, your choice of where to store state, how you handle a distributed environment where multiple servers are processing requests simultaneously, and what tradeoffs you'd accept. What failure modes does your design have, and how would you mitigate them?
